name: Joyful Honda Co.,Ltd.
summary: Joyful Honda Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the home center and renovation business in Japan. The company offers lumber, building materials, paint, tools, hardware, worker essentials, electrical fittings, and other materials and goods; daily goods, such as daily consumable goods, sundry supplies, hygiene products, drugs, healthcare products, drinks, and liquor; flower seedlings, vegetable seedlings, plants, compost, fertilizers, plant pots, bricks, paving stones, and other gardening materials; and plumbing supplies, agricultural materials, and large-scale machinery, as well as machinery, bush trimmers, power generators, and other equipment repair and maintenance services.
